domestic_evidence: No domestic-supply record could be retrieved. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report India revenue splits were not accessible: thecompanycheck.com, zaubacorp.com and tofler.in all returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, and the web_search tool was unavailable during this session (searx connection refused), so no GST or tender page could be located. No domestic contract, GST turnover figure or public-procurement award is asserted here.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs bill-of-lading records exist for all three related entities, with destination ports (Jeddah/Saudi Arabia, Nashville and Chicago/USA, Dammam/Saudi Arabia), HS codes (85014010, 85014090, 85030090) and BOL numbers (8376550, 8353645, 1139144, 9951167). Note the declared HS 850110 differs from the HS codes actually recorded on the shipments (85014010 / 85014090 for AC electric motors, 85030090 for generator laminations) — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the factual HS should be corrected to 85014010/85014090 (motors) and 85030090 (parts), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. The claimed legal entity REGAL REXNORD INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED is corroborated as a real, actively trading entity at the same Model Town address, and the name chain (Marathon Electric India / Marathon Electric Motors (India) / Regal Rexnord India) is consistent with the Regal Rexnord group's Indian motor operations. Domestic supply evidence is genuinely missing from public sources in this session — recorded as unknown, not as confirmed and not as 'none_found', because the registries were blocked rather than empty. Revenue and export volume figures: null — ImportKey shows shipment counts only, no value data, and no financials were retrievable; nothing invented. No sanctions, litigation or ownership issues were assessed here (out of scope for this role).
